payload.leagueSummary: NET is still a knife fight up top, with KeithK75, Dan94, and MattF all hanging around the front of the board and nobody exactly running away with the thing. Under the hood, the loudest signal is that the cleanest ball-strikers are also the ones cashing the most gross wins, while the chaos merchants are leaking strokes in either the short game, the putter, or both. There’s a real split between players who can keep the golf ball moving forward and players who can keep the round from turning into a public incident.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 is the gold standard right now: elite tee-to-green, efficient putting, and basically no dead spots. When he’s not winning, he’s usually still making the rest of the room look like they borrowed clubs from a gas station.

Dan94 brings the loudest driver in the file and the best gross profile, which is great until the golf starts asking for restraint. The boom is real; the occasional messy trail of doubles says the ceiling comes with some fireworks.

The bottom half is a bar fight between bad irons and worse recovery. DREADFUL, IUDoc92, and BigTime are all giving up too many strokes around the greens or on the greens, which means the comeback math gets ugly fast.
